recap.text: Last time, a zombie climbed down my rope. So I kicked the window.

momA.text: Honey? It's your mother. Are you eating enough?

tv.text: Emergency broadcast. Rescue vans are waiting at street level. The last pickup is at sunrise.

goal.text: Sunrise is in forty-eight minutes. And I'm ten floors up.

rent.text: He's still mad about the rent.

hall2.text: The hallway is full of zombies. But at the end... a fire hose. A hundred feet long.

rule.text: One rule. Don't make a sound.

only.text: Of course. He doesn't care about phones. Only rent.

end.text: Part three. Follow, before my landlord catches me.
